_comment: Sidecar for scene6_1.usd (a byte copy of scene6_0.usd: same table, same dome). Same objects as scene6_0 but spread WIDE in y so a single YAM arm cannot reach them all -- this is the bimanual layout used by eval/yam_tiptop_eval.py --bimanual. With the base resting on the table at (0.24, 0, 0.0551), a cuRobo IK sweep over top-down grasps puts the left arm's reach at y >= -0.17 and the right arm's at y <= +0.17, so blue_toy at y=+0.30 is LEFT-only, brown_toy at y=-0.30 is RIGHT-only, and pink_toy plus the plate sit near y=0 where both arms reach. Poses are world metres; the table-top collider surface is at z=0.0451, so objects start just above it and settle. Meshes are shared with scene 6 variant 0.
